data.gender_notes: Neerav is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Neerav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neeraja' which means 'lotus-born'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted sitting on a lotus flower. Therefore, the name Neerav symbolizes a divine connection to Lord Vishnu and the spiritual journey towards enlightenment. The name Neerav carries the meaning “Lotus-born” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neerav usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus-born and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name connected to the divine and symbolizing spiritual growth.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neerav total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
